scope: Current V1 preparation claims, immutable issued results, owner-only accepted outcome retrieval, access/control fencing and historical compatibility.

findings.original: Publication used PostgreSQL now(), which is fixed at transaction start. A transaction starting before expiry and then waiting for the owner lock could publish an expired claim.
findings.verifiedFix: TTL creation, ready reuse, claim reclamation, publication and current-job commit checks now use clock_timestamp(). Publication still requires the exact computing attempt and a live lease before updating result/expiry.
findings.regression: SYS-04: a claim expiring while publication waits for the player lock cannot publish
findings.testAssessment: The regression starts a publication transaction, confirms it is actually blocked on the PostgreSQL player row using pg_stat_activity, crosses a 200ms claim expiry, then releases the lock and asserts rejection plus unchanged game, absent current job and absent accepted command receipt.
findings.independentVerification: Read the final SQL and regression source; no independent rerun requested or performed.

findings.area: prepare cached legacy action-only job source attribution
findings.original: Supported legacy action-only jobs have no prepared analysis. Ready reuse labeled them code even when there was exactly one legal move.
findings.verifiedFix: The cached response retains forced provenance when a legacy job's validated current seat observation has one legal move; structured jobs retain their recorded analysis provenance. Reuse does not recompute or update original result/expiry.
findings.regression: SYS-04: ready legacy action-only singleton retains forced provenance without recomputation
findings.testAssessment: The regression reaches a real singleton bot choice through legal reducers, seeds an action-only ready job, installs an analyzer that throws if called, and checks forced attribution, the original receipt ID and exact unchanged stored job.
findings.independentVerification: Read the final predicate and regression source; included in the reported final 15/15 preparation suite.

reviewedBoundaries: Authenticated owner-row transactions still scope command receipts and ready trials by player_id; foreign receipts are not projected and revoked sessions fail identity checks.
Accepted outcomes are returned before new game/revision/control/coverage checks or analysis; recovery itself cannot advance gameplay or start a worker.
The unique computing claim and player lock prevent concurrent ordinary /prepare computations for the same game revision; attempt identity rejects superseded publications.

Ready work is reused without extending expiry or replacing result. Replacement preparation uses a fresh issued ID, preserving the old result/expiry in preparation_attempts while retaining the unique current jobs pointer.
Starting access generation, control lease, current revision, actor observation, decision identity and policy are checked at publication; access/control are checked again at acceptance.
The Hearts pass remains one atomic bundle and now rejects access-generation changes during preparation.
Public status returns accepted/unknown only; ready trial retrieval returns the previously stored safe public DTO. Client mutation success/reconciliation refreshes the current safe session separately.

referencedTests.sourceHashMatch: All overlapping independently hashed source files match the service execution artifact.
referencedTests.attribution: Execution is reported by urgent_prepare and its saved artifact. This reviewer performed final source/test inspection only.

scopeLimits: This closes the two actionable peer-review findings in the current repair; it is not complete SYS-04/05/07 or M03/V2 platform acceptance.
Synchronous Node computation, hard interruption, general execution admission and retained-history performance remain outside this source review.
Tests use multiple service instances with PostgreSQL, not separate OS server processes.
No new tests, database/provider calls, full-suite run, runtime edits or commit were performed by this final review.
The root agent owns final integrated/native/full-suite acceptance.
